newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber extends gains on Thai rain.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber extends gains on Thai rain.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices extended gains at the close, helped by the current rainy spell in Thailand which may cause further supply disruptions, dealers said.
But they said trading was very quiet on a lack of overseas enquiries and sellers' reserve.
"Nobody wants to do anything. I think sellers are watching the supply situation in Thailand," said one dealer. "I did not hear of any enquiries today."
A firmer Tokyo market in the morning had also supported earlier prices, the dealers said.
